scope: Mandatory complete thematic inventory of final Knave 2e map creation and hexcrawl; no rules extracted until primary text is readable.

source.edition: Knave Second Edition, final published edition; exact printing/file hash unknown
source.page_numbering: unknown until final book is supplied; do not borrow draft page numbers
limitations: Only publisher metadata and limited preview access were checked; no complete final-edition text available.
Owner's product hypothesis is not a source rule or proof of completeness.
No rules or numeric profiles inferred from search snippets, reviews or Knave 1e.

status_dictionary.yes: Реализовано в проверенном контуре, указан способ (включая ручной).
status_dictionary.no: Не обнаружено в проверенном коде/схеме; ограниченное отрицательное свидетельство.
status_dictionary.unverified: Не проверено; не считать ни реализацией, ни отсутствием.
status_dictionary.not_applicable: Отдельное требование из правила не следует; не включать в знаменатель.

evaluation_policy.manual_vs_automatic: Ручная заметка не равна генератору содержимого, движку правила или специальному полю.
evaluation_policy.full_game_support: Not assessed; complete thematic research and implemented support are separate.
evaluation_policy.comparison_unit: Independent procedure/recommendation/table, not each row; concrete operational_requirement mandatory for each applicable requirement.

shared_rules.propagation_status: No source rules or bindings added; compare analogous procedures before introducing any new canonical rule.
